nodes.name: holt briefs them on break-in entry
aliases: holt briefs them on break-in entry
nodes.description: Holt explains that investigators determined the workshop was entered through the east-facing window.
evidence: Our people examined the workshop this morning. The entry point was the east-facing WINDOW.

nodes.name: holt reveals latch was old damage
aliases: holt reveals latch was old damage
nodes.description: Holt states the window latch had been broken from age and neglect rather than by a recent forced entry, implying the thief exploited that weakness.
evidence: The latch was broken -- not forced recently, broken from age and neglect. The thief knew this or discovered it on approach.

nodes.name: felix denies knowing broken latch
nodes.description: Felix says he did not know the workshop window latch was broken.
evidence:
FELIX
I did not know the latch was broken.

nodes.name: holt identifies satchel as sable's
nodes.description: Holt announces that the satchel found near Felix's desk belongs to Sable.
evidence: The satchel found near your desk, Mr. Adler. It belongs to Miss Cross.

nodes.name: holt clears sable with alibi
nodes.description: Holt says independent witnesses place Sable at the market all morning, establishing an unambiguous alibi and clearing her of suspicion.
evidence: Three separate stall-keepers in the market square placed you there from before first bell until after the midday toll.
We have confirmed your whereabouts independently.
You were at the market all morning. That is an unambiguous alibi. Miss Cross is cleared of any suspicion.

nodes.name: sable expresses relief
nodes.description: Sable exhales and thanks Holt after being cleared.
evidence:
SABLE
(exhaling)
Thank you.

nodes.name: holt says someone framed sable
nodes.description: Holt warns that someone deliberately tried to implicate Sable using the satchel and is pursuing both the map and suspicion toward Felix's apprentice.
evidence: Do not thank me yet. Someone wanted you implicated.
That means they knew about the satchel or found it and used it.
The question is who benefits from the map and from casting doubt on your apprentice.

evidence: We do not have proof. Not yet. But I want both of you to be careful.
